title: Gordon Novel threatens Sheehan and is later hired by John Alexander for NIDS
summary: Dan Sheehan tells of Gordon Novel threatens Sheehan and is later hired by John Alexander for NIDS, about 1980s-1990s at Washington, D.C., and says they saw it or took part. As told, not a fact.

tellings.quote: mhm well Gordon Noel ends up later being hired by John Alexander whoa to be one of the investigators for nids

plain: Dan Sheehan, a lawyer, says that sometime in the 1980s or 1990s in Washington, a man named Gordon Novel threatened him. He says Novel was later hired by John Alexander as one of the investigators for NIDS, a private group that looked into UFOs and other strange events. He tells it to suggest unsettling links between the people around this subject.
